Soil carbon accumulation after afforestation of former croplands

Abstract

Afforestation is promoted as a climate solution, but soil carbon gains are uncertain. We sampled 86 paired forest and cropland sites across Central Europe. Topsoil carbon increased by 0.4 Mg per hectare per year during the first three decades, while subsoil carbon did not change.
